limitations: Executable isolation contract is declared by the operator, not verified by the sampler.
Ready signal semantics, if present, are defined by the measured host.
Very short-lived children and children reparented before discovery can be missed.
CPU includes observed descendants; terminated process totals retain the last observed value.
Working sets may double-count shared pages.
Peak memory is a sampled maximum, not an allocation high-water mark.
GPU and input latency are not measured.
The sampler and CIM queries add overhead.
Window visibility/workload is labeled by the operator, not enforced.
The launched app is left running; no process or profile cleanup is performed.

launch.isolationContract: Inspected fork Tauri host requires explicit isolated profile in benchmark mode, isolates WebView storage and disables game readers, capture integrations, login writes, pack installs and updates.
